real-estate and construction workflows into fast, reliable software.

- Approach: 3D-first — geometry-driven data, not spreadsheets of guesses

================================================================================
2. THE PRODUCT — TAKEOFF AUTO 3D
================================================================================

Takeoff Auto 3D is ImobX's first B2B application: an automated takeoff and
estimating tool for contractors, estimators and developers working with 3D
building models.

Tagline: "From 3D model to cost estimate. Automatically."

It reads a building model, measures every surface and produces a complete
material list and client-ready estimate in minutes, not days.

Key capabilities
----------------
- 3D model import: opens SketchUp models directly; inspects geometry, layers
  and structure with no manual redrawing.
- Automatic quantities: roof areas, surfaces and linear measurements are
  computed straight from the model — accurately, every time.
- Material assemblies: configurable material systems map every measured
  surface to the right products and labor items.
- Deviz-ready estimates: generates structured cost estimates (deviz) in
  Excel — internal SEM sheets and client-facing variants.
- Client-ready PDFs: exports polished, branded quote documents clients can
  sign off on — straight from the same data.
- Scenario pricing: compares material systems and price variants side by
  side to find the right margin for every bid.

Outputs
-------
- Excel estimate workbooks (internal SEM sheets and client-facing variants)
- Branded, client-ready PDF quote documents
- Material lists mapped to configurable assemblies

Typical result
--------------
A full takeoff that previously took days of manual measuring is produced in
minutes — over 40 real projects were processed during development and
validation.

================================================================================
3. WORKFLOW — THREE STEPS, ZERO MANUAL MEASURING
================================================================================

Step 1 — Model
    Open the project's SketchUp model. The app inspects the geometry and
    identifies roofs, surfaces and borders.

Step 2 — Measure
    Quantities are computed automatically — areas, perimeters and volumes —
    and mapped to the user's material assemblies.

Step 3 — Estimate
    Export a complete deviz in Excel and a client-ready PDF quote. Iterate
    pricing scenarios in seconds.

================================================================================
4. FAQ
================================================================================

Q: What is Takeoff Auto 3D?
A: Takeoff Auto 3D is an automated takeoff and estimating tool by ImobX. It
   reads a 3D building model, measures every surface and produces a complete
   material list and client-ready cost estimate in minutes instead of days.

Q: What input does it need?
A: A 3D building model — it opens SketchUp models directly and inspects the
   geometry, layers and structure with no manual redrawing.

Q: What does it produce?
A: A structured cost estimate (deviz) in Excel — internal SEM sheets and
   client-facing variants — plus a polished, branded PDF quote generated from
   the same data.

Q: Who is it for?
A: B2B: contractors, estimators and developers who prepare bids and quotes
   from 3D building models.

Q: How long does a takeoff take?
A: Minutes per full takeoff — quantities, material lists and estimates are
   computed automatically from the model's geometry.

Q: How is it priced?
A: Pricing is provided on request. Email contact@imobx.md or send a model to
   see the estimate Takeoff Auto 3D produces on a real project.

Q: What is ImobX?
A: ImobX is a software company for the real estate business, based in the
   Republic of Moldova. Takeoff Auto 3D is its first product; more real-estate
   and construction workflow software is planned.
